articles.title_en: Germany denies Russian art student a visa citing ‘security threat.’ Rights advocates call it a dangerous precedent.
articles.lead_en: The German Embassy in Moscow has denied a study visa to a graduate of the Design program at the Higher School of Economics (HSE) who had been accepted into a similar program at a German art university. Molnia, a human rights project for students, reported the refusal after reviewing the letter denying the visa.
